# ClassX

> > ClassX is an AI-powered learning platform offering interactive English lessons, phonics instruction, and intelligent tutoring tools for young learners.

ClassX combines traditional educational content (Alphablocks phonics, StoryBots videos, interactive storylines) with modern AI-assisted learning tools (homework helpers, grammar correction, conversation practice). The platform serves early years through high school students with a focus on English language learning and literacy development.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered learning
- Interactive lessons
- English language learning
- Phonics instruction
- Speaking practice
- Writing assistance
- Young learners
- Alphablocks
- StoryBots
- Video lessons
- Conversation practice
- Grammar correction
- Homework help
- Early literacy
- Language fluency

## Core Learning Programs

- [ClassX Home](https://classx.org): AI-powered learning platform with phonics, tutoring, and interactive English lessons
- [Phonics](https://classx.org/phonics): Alphablocks phonics course teaching systematic synthetic phonics for early literacy
- [Learn the Alphabet](https://classx.org/learn-the-alphabet): Interactive alphabet learning with ABC Pirates series and gamified sticker rewards
- [Storyline](https://classx.org/storyline): Interactive story-based English lessons for speaking practice and language fluency
- [Video Lessons](https://classx.org/video-lessons): Comprehensive library of free interactive English video lessons for learners
- [StoryBots](https://classx.org/storybots): StoryBots animated educational videos teaching science and early learning topics

## AI-Powered Speaking & Conversation Tools

- [AI Conversation Practice](https://classx.org/ai-conversation-practice): AI conversation practice tool for English speaking fluency and dialogue exercises
- [Interview a Historical Figure](https://classx.org/interview-a-historical-figure): AI simulation tool enabling interactive interviews with historical figures for learning
- [Book Chat](https://classx.org/book-chat): AI-powered book discussion tool for analyzing classic literature and textbooks

## AI Writing & Grammar Assistance

- [AI Grammar Correction](https://classx.org/ai-grammar-correction): AI writing assistant detecting and correcting grammar, punctuation, and spelling errors
- [AI Essay-Writing Guide - High School](https://classx.org/ai-essay-writing-guide-high-school): AI-assisted essay writing guide covering structure, thesis, and brainstorming
- [AI Essay-Writing Guide - Elementary School](https://classx.org/ai-essay-writing-guide-elementary-school): Step-by-step AI essay writing guide for elementary students with tutoring support
- [AI Sentence Generator](https://classx.org/ai-sentence-generator): AI sentence generation tool with CEFR language proficiency levels for learners

## AI Content Creation Tools

- [AI Children's Story Generator](https://classx.org/ai-childrens-story-generator): AI tool generating personalized children's stories in various author styles
- [AI Lyrics Generator](https://classx.org/ai-lyrics-generator): AI tool generating custom song lyrics based on existing melodies and themes

## Learning Support & Reference

- [AI Homework Helpers Archive](https://classx.org/ai-homework-helper): AI-powered homework assistance tools integrating ChatGPT and Wolfram Alpha
- [AI Country Guide](https://classx.org/ai-country-guide): AI country guide covering global AI policy and international AI developments
